title: Truncation to a computed length
statement: If $f,g : \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}^*$ are polynomial-time computable, then the function sending each bit string $x$ to the prefix of $g(x)$ of length $|f(x)|$ is polynomial-time computable; if $g(x)$ is shorter, this prefix is all of $g(x)$.
replaced: If $f$ and $g$ are polynomial-time computable functions on bit strings, then so is the function sending $x$ to the first $|f(x)|$ bits of $g(x)$ (all of $g(x)$ when it is shorter).
